intervenants.odahTitre: Expert in Strategic Governance and Port Development
intervenants.odahBio: Chief Executive Officer of CRF Perfection, Dr. William ODAH is an international expert in strategic governance, active across the United States, Canada, Europe and Africa. For many years, he has supported institutions and companies in West Africa and beyond in their port development, training and organizational structuring projects. His expertise is built around three levers of performance to meet the challenges of digital transformation: strategic marketing, for competitive positioning and service value creation; process digitalization, for operational optimization and efficiency; and organizational compliance, for resilience, governance and regulatory conformity. Working with public and private stakeholders in the maritime and logistics sector across four continents, he is recognized for his pragmatic approach combining institutional change management, executive capacity building and strategic support for high-stakes port projects.
intervenants.biegniebeBio: Marc BIEGNIEBE is Chief Executive Officer of ANAXAR, a road transport company operating along the corridors linking the Port of Lomé to hinterland countries — Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger. With over 10 years of experience in the port and cross-border logistics chain, he works on corridor fluidity, customs clearance and transport digitalization issues in West Africa.
intervenants.tchoboTitre: Expert in Digital Transformation & Digital Solutions Consultant
intervenants.tchoboBio: Rénato TCHOBO is Chief Digital & IT Officer at CRF Perfection, where he leads web development, digital strategy and the digital transformation of institutional and event-related projects. A freelance consultant in web development and community management, he designs and deploys complete digital platforms — from concept to production — for organizations based in Cotonou and internationally. His expertise covers structuring complex digital projects, process automation and strategic support for digital transformation.
intervenants.balsomiBio: Babel BALSOMI is CEO of the HIERO DIGITAL INTERNATIONAL group, active in Africa, Europe and Canada. An expert in offensive cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and digital transformation, she is notably recognized for her research on the security of large language models. Founder of several organizations dedicated to cybersecurity, training and digital inclusion in Africa (HDI, Hiero Academy, H&C IT Academy, CONNECT-IA), she supports institutions and businesses in strengthening their digital resilience. She regularly speaks at international forums dedicated to cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.
intervenants.abialaBio: M. Abiala MODESTE is Commercial Director at Bolloré Transport & Logistics, where he leads business development and strategic partnerships across port and logistics operations in West Africa. With extensive experience in international supply chains, he supports economic and institutional stakeholders in optimizing cargo flows and deploying innovative port solutions. His expertise spans key account commercial strategy, market development and the digitalization of port services across Africa.
